# javaabu/notifications

> Notifications for Laravel, built on Laravel's own. A notification extends Javaabu\Notifications\BaseNotification and defines message() once, returning a NotificationMessage (title, lines, action, icon, colour, thumbnail, subject model, data); the package builds mail (branded, right to left for Dhivehi), database, broadcast, FCM (laravel-notification-channels/fcm, optional) and SMS (javaabu/sms-notifications) from it, sends each notifiable only the channels it can receive and hasn't turned off, in its own language. It ships a notifications page and a live bell in Blade (javaabu/forms v2, <x-notifications::bell>) and Inertia React (@javaabu/forms and Onu, NotificationBell from @javaabu/notifications through javaabu/manifest), updated over Laravel Reverb or by polling, with routes from Route::notifications(), an overridable controller and policy, and permissions through javaabu/permissions. With javaabu/translatable, database notifications are stored in every active language.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/notifications/.

## Rules

- Extend `Javaabu\Notifications\BaseNotification` and implement `message(object $notifiable): NotificationMessage`. Don't write `toMail()`, `toArray()`, `toSms()` or `toFcm()` by hand unless a channel needs something the message can't say; then call `parent::toMail()` and change it.
- List channels in `protected array $channels = ['database', 'mail', 'sms', 'fcm']`. Don't filter them in `via()` yourself: BaseNotification already drops channels the notifiable has no route for and channels it turned off. `broadcast` is added by itself when live updates are on.
- Notifiables use `Javaabu\Notifications\Concerns\Notifiable` instead of Laravel's `Notifiable`. For SMS, implement `SmsNotifiable` with `HasSmsNumber` and `routeNotificationForSms()`; for push, `routeNotificationForFcm()`.
- Put every user-facing string through `__()` inside `message()`: it runs in the notifiable's locale (`HasLocalePreference` or the `locale` attribute). Add Dhivehi to the app's `lang/dv.json`. Use Thaana in tests.
- Pass the model the notification is about with `->subject($model)`, so it's saved as a morph and the page can link to it. Implement `NotificationSubject::notificationUrl()` on models instead of building URLs in every notification.
- Icons are Onu semantic names (`bell`, `mail`, `send`, `success`, `warning`, `user`, …). Colours are `primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`, `neutral`.
- Register routes with `Route::notifications()` inside the app's `web` group, once per guard: `Route::notifications(['guard' => 'web_admin', 'prefix' => 'admin/notifications', 'name' => 'admin.notifications'])`. Link to a notification through `notifications.show` (it marks it read and redirects), never straight to its URL.
- Show the bell with `<x-notifications::bell />` in Blade, or share `BellData::make($request->user())` with Inertia and render `<NotificationBell bell={props.notifications} />`.
- Preferences: implement `HasNotificationPreferences` with `ManagesNotificationPreferences` (a `notification_preferences` JSON column) and save with `setNotificationPreference('order-shipped', 'mail', false)`. Required channels (`notifications.required_channels`, `database`) can't be turned off.
- Everyone manages their own notifications without permissions. Give `view_others_notifications` / `delete_others_notifications` to support roles. Run `php artisan permissions:sync`.
- Brand mail once in `notifications.mail.branding` (logo URL, colours, footer). Mailables use the same look with `$theme = 'notifications::mail.theme'` and `<x-mail::branded>`.
- Test with `Notification::fake()` and `assertSentTo(..., fn ($n, $channels) => ...)`, or `notifyNow($notification, ['database'])` and read `$user->notifications()->first()->title()`.
